Jobs

Join a team that treats every rider like family.

We're currently hiring drivers to serve seniors and clients with disabilities across the Denver Metro area.

Now Hiring

Driver

Job Description

Transport seniors and clients with disabilities to and from non-emergency medical and non-medical appointments in the Denver Metro area.

Job Purpose

Duties involve operating the assigned vehicle in a safe, reliable, and professional manner while being courteous, patient, and helpful to all passengers.

Essential Job Requirements

  • Valid Colorado driver's license with at least three years of driving experience.
  • Clean motor vehicle driving record.
  • No DUI or DWI convictions.
  • No suspended, revoked, denied, or cancelled license reinstatements in the last five years.
  • Not more than four points in the last twelve months, or six points in the past three years.
  • At least 23 years old.
  • Able to pass an FBI criminal background check.
  • Able to pass a drug test.
  • Able to push a client weighing 250 lbs.+ on a wheelchair up/down ramps.
  • Available Monday–Friday.
  • Able to follow GPS and use a smartphone.
Note: the minimum driver age is listed differently across our source materials (23 vs. 25) — pending confirmation before this is finalized.
